id: 03_Why Do Routine Laser Maintenance -- Laser Maintenance Group Kiser
title: 激光设备为什么要例行维护
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/03_Why Do Routine Laser Maintenance -- Laser Maintenance Group Kiser.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/03_Why Do Routine Laser Maintenance -- Laser Maintenance Group Kiser/src.py

points.S4: 开盖维护时的激光风险

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在桌前，桌上摆着一个黄铜镜座和几样小零件
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits at a dark workbench with a brass lens holder and a few small parts laid out in front of it.
shots.narration: 这一课聊聊：激光设备为什么要维护。
overlay: 激光设备为什么要例行维护

shots.scene: 日历、时钟、扳手、锁、警示牌五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a calendar, a clock, a wrench, a padlock, and a blank warning tag. No people.
shots.narration: 多久修一次，怎么修才安全。

shots.scene: 工程训练中心，切割机屏幕上一个空白提醒图标在闪
shots.prompt_en: In an engineering training workshop, a blank reminder icon blinks on the control screen of a laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 切割机提示：该做例行维护了。

shots.scene: 老周看着一摞待加工的订单，摆手
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at a tall stack of blank job sheets and waves his hand dismissively.
shots.narration: 老周说：活儿这么多，先别停。

shots.scene: 老李拿着一个烧黑的镜座，表情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blackened brass lens holder with a serious expression.
shots.narration: 老李拿出一个坏零件：这就是拖的后果。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 到底该不该停？我们算一笔账。

shots.scene: 桌上排着黄铜镜座、金黄色透镜、铜喷嘴和一段弯折的铜管
shots.prompt_en: On a dark bench: a brass lens holder, a golden round lens in a clear box, a copper nozzle and a bent copper tube. No people.
shots.narration: 这些是切割头里拆下来的零件。

shots.scene: 示意图：切割头剖面，镜片、喷嘴、冷却水管的位置
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a laser cutting head showing where the lens, nozzle and cooling water tube sit. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片聚焦，喷嘴吹气，水管冷却。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套，用手电照着镜座中间的透镜孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing gloves, shines a flashlight into the center opening of the lens holder.
shots.narration: 它们天天受热、受烟，最容易坏。

shots.scene: 老李翻开一本空白设备说明书，指着一页
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a blank equipment manual and points to a page.
shots.narration: 维护多久做一次，先看厂家要求。

shots.scene: 说明书图标连到一个周期循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a manual connected to a circular arrow showing a repeating cycle. No people.
shots.narration: 到点就做，形成固定的周期。

shots.scene: 一个运行计时器图标，旁边是日历被淡化
shots.prompt_en: A large running-hours counter icon in front, with a faded calendar icon behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 周期按机器运行的小时数算。

shots.scene: 左边一个太阳图标的机器慢慢走表，右边日夜交替的机器飞快走表
shots.prompt_en: Split screen: on the left a machine with a sun icon and a slow counter, on the right a machine under alternating sun and moon icons with a fast counter. No people.
shots.narration: 开一班和开两班，到期时间差很多。

shots.scene: 日历上的维护标记从远处挪到很近
shots.prompt_en: A maintenance mark on a calendar slides from far away to just a few weeks ahead. No people.
shots.narration: 开得越多，维护就来得越快。

shots.scene: 老周站在忙碌的车间里，指着机器摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in a busy workshop, pointing at a running machine and shaking his head.
shots.narration: 机器还在转，谁都不想停下来。

shots.scene: 一张被一推再推的日历图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a calendar with a maintenance mark being pushed back again and again by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 维护一拖再拖，隐患越攒越多。

shots.scene: 一个小小的镜片图标，价格标签很小
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small round lens with a tiny blank price tag. No people.
shots.narration: 坏掉的零件，本身不一定贵。

shots.scene: 镜片裂开，旁边冒出火苗和烟
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cracked lens with a small flame and smoke beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可它一坏，可能起火、毁了机头。

shots.scene: 一个大大的沙漏，旁边是停着的切割机
shots.prompt_en: A large hourglass beside a stopped laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 最贵的，其实是停机的时间。

shots.scene: 日历上两天被划掉，等维修人员；再加一个扳手和时钟
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with two days crossed out while waiting for a repair technician, then a wrench and a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 等人来修，修好，再重新调机。

shots.scene: 老周看着停着的机器和堆积的订单，叹气
shots.prompt_en: The older man sighs while looking at a stopped machine and a growing pile of blank job sheets.
shots.narration: 算下来，定期停一停最划算。

shots.scene: 老李在空白设备台账上记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes in a blank equipment logbook beside the machine.
shots.narration: 把维护写进计划，记进设备台账。

shots.scene: 台账图标里有日期、内容、签名三栏图标，都打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a logbook page with three columns marked by a calendar, a wrench and a signature icon, each ticked. No people.
shots.narration: 做了什么、谁做的，都要有记录。

shots.scene: 老李胸前挂着空白工作证，站在打开的机柜前
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing a blank ID badge, stands in front of an open machine cabinet.
shots.narration: 维护激光设备，只由授权人员来做。

shots.scene: 拿着螺丝刀伸向机柜的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student reaching into a machine cabinet with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不能自己开柜子修。

shots.scene: 老李关闭总电源，挂上挂锁和空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the main power and attaches a padlock and a blank warning tag.
shots.narration: 维护前断电，上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 机柜里的高压电源图标，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a high voltage power supply inside the cabinet next to an hourglass. No people.
shots.narration: 激光电源有高压，断电后还会存电。

shots.scene: 老李用验电工具确认，再开始工作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks with a voltage tester before starting work.
shots.narration: 按规程等待放电、验电，再动手。

shots.section_title: 开盖维护时的激光风险
shots.scene: 机器外壳打开，里面一道光路示意线，旁边激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The machine housing is open, showing a beam path line inside, next to a laser warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳一打开，联锁保护就可能失效。
overlay: 开盖维护时的激光风险

shots.section_title: 开盖维护时的激光风险
shots.scene: 老李戴上激光防护眼镜，门口挂着警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on laser safety goggles while a warning sign hangs on the closed workshop door.
shots.narration: 需要出光调试，戴对眼镜、清场挂牌。

shots.section_title: 开盖维护时的激光风险
shots.scene: 旁观者站在打开的机器旁的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bystander standing next to an open laser machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 维护区域，无关人员不得靠近。

shots.scene: 一小瓶清洁溶剂和擦镜纸放在托盘里
shots.prompt_en: A small bottle of optical cleaning solvent and lens tissue on a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 擦镜片用的溶剂，大多易燃。

shots.scene: 老李在通风处少量倒出溶剂，旁边没有火源
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pours a small amount of solvent in a ventilated area with no ignition sources nearby.
shots.narration: 少量取用，通风，远离火源。

shots.scene: 用过的擦镜纸放进带盖的金属废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Used lens tissues go into a lidded metal waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的纸放进带盖的桶里。

shots.scene: 金黄色的透镜裂成几块，放在托盘里
shots.prompt_en: A golden lens cracked into several pieces lying on a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 镜片碎了、烧坏了，别徒手碰。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套，把碎镜片装进密封袋，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing gloves, places the broken lens pieces into a sealed bag with a blank label.
shots.narration: 有的镜片材料有毒，装袋按规定回收。

shots.scene: 吹气、手指擦碎镜片的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person blowing on and wiping a broken lens with bare fingers, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不吹、不擦、不掰，交给专人处理。

shots.scene: 冷却水管接头处渗出水珠，流向电线
shots.prompt_en: Water drips from a cooling tube fitting toward an electrical cable inside the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却水管漏水，旁边就是电线。

shots.scene: 老李先关电源，再擦干水迹、更换接头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer first switches off the power, then wipes up the water and replaces the fitting.
shots.narration: 先断电，再擦干、修好接头。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现计时器、台账、证书、锁、眼镜五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: a running-hours counter, a logbook, a certificate, a padlock, and laser safety goggles.
shots.narration: 按时维护，记进台账，授权人员做。

shots.scene: 老李在锁好的配电箱旁，戴着防护眼镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands by a locked power switch, wearing laser safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 断电放电、戴对眼镜、溶剂远离火。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老周、老李站在维护好的切割机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the older man and the facility engineer beside a well-maintained laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 定期停一停，机器和人都安全。
